scope: Urban residential planning screening; minimum requirements, not measured demand or approval

water.note: 80 is the inner-urban domestic minimum; actual demand requires local time-series and urban-class/context. Park/flower-garden rate is not automatically applicable to every private green surface. Other city-wide water categories, losses and firefighting are not included in this project check.

schools.exception: Complex terrain and low population density; not a universal lower-secondary radius
schools.note: Minimum planning provision, not a forecast of actual enrollment. Service radius is assessed separately from walk-network distance. School classification and remaining places are not inferred from OSM amenity alone.

apartment_density.note: Apartment-group screening only. Interpolation uses adjacent area/height values. Mixed heights, podium/tower groups and non-residential developments require a separate assessment; no automatic compliance pass.

related_standards.use: Water-network design reference; no unverified numeric values copied into this catalog
